props.eyebrow: Live music at Denver Union Station
props.title: The Crawford Hotel
props.lede: The Crawford Hotel is inside Denver Union Station, and its lobby is the station’s Great Hall, with its arched windows and chandeliers. An event here happens in one of the most beautiful spaces in the city.

headingText.html: Trains to the airport leave from just outside, so it’s an easy place for guests who are flying in. This December, our string duo plays the Cooper Lounge for a company holiday party.

props.title: Event spaces at the Crawford Hotel

rows.text: The Cooper Lounge is on the mezzanine, one floor above the Great Hall, with about 2,100 sq ft for receptions of up to 80 guests. It has 28-foot cast-iron windows on one side and a view down into the Great Hall on the other.
The Great Hall has high ceilings, arches and chandeliers, with lounge seating and its own bar. It hosts semi-private events of up to 350 guests, or 270 seated.
The Webb Gallery is in the station’s original foundations, about 2,400 sq ft with a built-in bar, for 20 to 150 guests.
The McWhinney Room is about 1,050 sq ft, with stone walls from the original foundations, for up to 70 guests.
The Terminal Bar’s plaza is outdoors on Wynkoop Street, facing LoDo, with about 3,500 sq ft and a satellite bar for receptions of up to 220.

props.title: Live music in the Cooper Lounge and the Great Hall
props.lede: It’s a lovely fit for holiday parties, receptions and cocktail hours.

props.title: Live music in the Webb Gallery and on the Terminal Bar plaza
props.lede: They’re great for wedding receptions, rehearsal dinners and parties.

rows.text: Every private event at the station has its own service manager, and an event captain on the day, and we coordinate load-in and setup with them.
Our acts bring their own sound system, sized to the space. The hotel also has AV equipment on site.
The hotel’s valet can’t take vehicles over 6'6" or with trailers, so we plan where the act parks and unloads ahead of time.
The Great Hall is the hotel’s lobby and an entrance to the trains, so it stays open to the public. We set the music at a level that works for a shared space.
The station lights its tree at the Grand Illumination each year, and carolers sing in the Great Hall.
There’s valet at the Wynkoop Street entrance, and the A Line to Denver International Airport stops just outside, about 37 minutes away.

props.title: Ask about your date at the Crawford Hotel.
props.lede: Send us your date, and we can put together live music for your event at the hotel, from a string duo in the Cooper Lounge to a band in the Webb Gallery.
